title.narrative: OAS Peace Mission in Colombia 2025-2026 - Support to MAPP/OEA Colombia 2025-2026

description.narrative: During 2025-2027, the MAPP/OAS aims to strengthen the peacebuilding processes in the regions most affected by the internal armed conflict, criminality and inequalities through the following: 1. Accompany and support the dialogue, negotiation and endorsement processes, and the implementation of the agreements reached between the Colombian government and the different armed groups with a national or local presence, within the frame of the Total Peace Law. 2. Strengthen the process through which the Colombian state makes decisions to address situations of the armed conflict and social unrest; its impact on the communities; and the transformations of the dynamics of violence. 3. Strengthen the decision making process of the Colombian state, the cooperation between the state and civil society, and the capacity of social actors to influence the formulation of public policies directed to victims, peace, gender, protection of the environment, territorial transformation and development.

The overall objective of the MAPP/OAS (OAS Peace Mission in Colombia) is to support peace-building in Colombia through monitoring, accompaniment, technical assistance and capacity building, mainly in the regions and with the communities most affected by the internal armed conflict.
MAPP/OAS aims to strengthen the peace-building processes in the regions most affected by the internal armed conflict, criminality and inequalities through the following:
1. Accompany and support the dialogue, negotiation and endorsement processes, and the implementation of the agreements reached between the Colombian government and the different armed groups with a national or local presence, within the frame of the Total Peace Law.
2. Strengthen the process through which the Colombian state makes decisions to address situations of the armed conflict and social unrest; its impact on the communities; and the transformations of the dynamics of violence.
3. Strengthen the decision-making process of the Colombian state, the cooperation between the state and civil society, and the capacity of social actors to influence the formulation of public policies directed to victims, peace, gender, protection of the environment, territorial transformation and development.
